unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 10 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.2 - THEME 3: PERSONAL LIFE & WELL-BEING

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will design a project on the concept of ''Personal Life and Wellbeing'' by focusing on the importance of planning for long-term personal fulfilment. The Project will include setting priorities, achieving balance, and addressing challenges and barriers. Students will discuss how personal choices in sports such as relaxing pastimes or adrenaline-filled extreme activities influence their physical and mental health. Students will also cover their preferences in films and music by emphasising their role in shaping emotional well-being and cultural awareness. Students are free to expand their projects to show how hobbies and entertainment contribute to personal growth and satisfaction. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as planning lifetime personal well-being; personal choices and preferences for sports and extreme sports; personal choices for films and film genres; music and music genres'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school may know what planning life-time personal well-being; personal choices and preferences for sports and extreme sports; personal choices for films and film genres; music and music genres mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''personal life and well-being'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year, and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.

Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/ or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about planning life-time personal well-being; personal choices and preferences for sports; personal choices for films and film genres; music and music genres in English by using the target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Stress-Free Solutions The teacher asks students to role-play a counsellor-client session and then hold a group discussion on managing stress. Students discuss problems by using hobbies as a solution. S/he gives a scenario such as ''You have a friend who is overwhelmed with stress and needs advice on how to balance his/her life''. Then students write a recommendation plan. For example: ''Start with exercising to ease physical tension. Attend an orchestra to calm your mind. End the day with a comedy film to lift your spirits''. Following this session, they role-play all of the recommendations. The teacher provides constructive and supportive feedback on the use of language, originality of the ideas and accuracy. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about human illnesses and diseases and give advice in English through a role-play activity by using the target vocabulary. Activity 1: Read and Categorise The teacher prepares a reading text related to personal choices and preferences for sports and extreme sports; personal choices for films and film genres; music and music genres. Students read the text and categorise vocabulary from the text into sports, music, and films such as sports: ______ (skateboarding, snowboarding, exercising); music: ______ (orchestra, gig, rhythm, lyrics); films: ______ (thriller, comedy) by discussing with their peers. Then they make sentences with the words and share them with the class. The teacher gives feedback on their work for accuracy and collaboration. At the end of the activity, the teacher guides students to play digital word games to use the target vocabulary to support their learning in an interactive and fun way. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
